SELECT
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___amt`
FROM orders AS orders
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM customers AS customers
    INNER JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    INNER JOIN region_events AS customers__regions__region_events
      ON customers__regions.id = customers__regions__region_events.region_id
    WHERE
      orders.customer_id = customers.id
      AND CAST(customers__regions.pop + customers__regions__region_events.value AS FLOAT64) > 0
  )
